creatives.title: Launch hero: AeroRun is here
creatives.headline: Light on your feet. Loud on your feed.
creatives.concept: The campaign line, the shoe at hero scale and the price, stated confidently. The single post that defines the launch.
creatives.direction: White canvas, Ember colourway at 80% width, headline top-left, '₹5,999 · Official store' price chip bottom-left.
creatives.caption:
AeroRun is here.

A lightweight lifestyle runner that looks good in the fit check and still feels light at 9 pm. ₹5,999, only at the official store.

Tap the link in bio to pick your colourway.

Ember. Midnight. Chalk. Sage.

The look you've been saving for, without saving for six months.

AeroRun: ₹5,999. Official store, free size exchange, no guesswork.

creatives.title: Real ones only
